script_text: Stop! Aries, your ruler Mars is igniting a firestorm today. Mars in your 4th House of Home squares Mercury in your 1st House of Self, sparking impulsive arguments and restless energy. You'll feel torn between domestic duties and personal ambitions. In love, Venus in your 12th House trines Jupiter in your 4th, creating intensely romantic private moments. Singles, a soulmate may appear through a family gathering; taken, sharing vulnerabilities deepens intimacy. Career-wise, Venus sextiles Pluto in your 10th House, revealing hidden opportunities in healing or creative fields—perhaps a home-based role. But Mercury squares Pluto: in workplace talks, one snappy remark could spark a power struggle with superiors. Avoid signing contracts today; miscommunication is guaranteed. Neptune in your 12th House adds a dreamy, intuitive edge to all interactions. Follow for tomorrow's reading to navigate this volatile transit.
